=== 相对链接必须基于 resp.url ===

code:
# URL 规范化与去重
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit, urlunsplit, parse_qsl, urlencode, urlparse

TRACKING = {"utm_source", "utm_medium", "utm_campaign", "spm", "from"}

def normalize(url):
    s = urlsplit(url)
    scheme = s.scheme.lower()
    host = s.hostname.lower() if s.hostname else ""
    if s.port and not ((scheme == "http" and s.port == 80) or (scheme == "https" and s.port == 443)):
        host += ":%d" % s.port
    path = s.path or "/"
    q = [(k, v) for k, v in parse_qsl(s.query, keep_blank_values=True) if k.lower() not in TRACKING]
    q.sort()
    return urlunsplit((scheme, host, path, urlencode(q), ""))   # 丢掉 fragment

raws = [
    "HTTP://Example.COM/a/b?b=2&a=1#top",
    "https://example.com/a/b?a=1&b=2",
    "https://EXAMPLE.com/a/b?a=1&b=2&utm_source=x",
    "https://example.com:443/a/b?a=1&b=2",
    "https://example.com/a/b?a=1&b=2&spm=abc",
    "https://example.com/a/b?a=1&b=2",
]
print("原始 URL -> 规范化结果")
seen = {}
for i, u in enumerate(raws, 1):
    n = normalize(u)
    print("  %d) %-52s -> %s" % (i, u, n))
    seen.setdefault(n, []).append(i)
print("")
print("原始 %d 条, 去重后 %d 条" % (len(raws), len(seen)))
for n, idx in seen.items():
    if len(idx) > 1:
        print("  合并 %s <- 第 %s 条" % (n, idx))

print("")
print("=== 相对链接必须基于 resp.url ===")
base_actual = "https://example.com/list/2/page.html"
for rel in ["../next.html", "detail/1.html", "/root.html", "?p=3"]:
    print("  %-16s -> %s" % (rel, urljoin(base_actual, rel)))
print("若误用初始请求 URL 作基准, '../' 的层级会拼错")
